[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r product </run/bashos-parity-vm-identity || exit 125

cat > "$HOME/rrl.zone" <<'ZONE'
$ORIGIN example.test.
$TTL 300
@ IN SOA ns.example.test. hostmaster.example.test. 1 3600 600 86400 300
@ IN NS ns.example.test.
ns IN A 192.0.2.53
www IN A 192.0.2.10

: > "$HOME/rrl-control-reached-failures.jsonl" || exit 125

cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r product </run/bashos-parity-vm-identity || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && ${marker,,} == ${product,,} && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$ ]] || exit 125
set +e
[[ $(type -t dns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
run_case() {
  mode=$1; port=$2; opt=$3
  dns auth-serve --zone "$HOME/rrl.zone" --listen 127.0.0.1 --port "$port" --max-queries 20 $opt </dev/null >"$HOME/rrl-$mode.server.stdout" 2>"$HOME/rrl-$mode.server.log" & srv=$!
  /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-auth-rrl-observe-r3.py "$mode" "$port" "$srv"
  obs=$?; pending=false; status=null
  for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do kill -0 "$srv" 2>/dev/null || break; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05; done
  if kill -0 "$srv" 2>/dev/null; then pending=true; else wait "$srv"; status=$?; fi
  printf '{"observer_status":%d,"server_status":%s,"pending_cleanup":%s}\n' "$obs" "$status" "$pending" > "$HOME/rrl-$mode-cleanup.json"
  [[ $pending == false ]]
}
if run_case control 21751 '--no-rrl'; then
  run_case limited 21752 '--rrl-rps 1 --rrl-window 1 --rrl-slip 2'
fi
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dns-auth-rrl-review-r3.py
cases.oracle: Independent hand-encoded DNS queries and synthetic A zone. On a single loopback socket, 20 unique IDs test opt-out control and a bounded rps=1/window=1/slip=2 burst. Owned candidate TCP/UDP socket inodes, process starttime, send timestamps, server completion and raw datagrams are recorded. Positive control and candidate summary corroborate but cannot independently prove receipt or ordering of absent datagrams; review treats this as an explicit attribution limitation.
cases.comparison: Require a fully qualified no-RRL control with twenty valid non-truncated authoritative A responses. Compare the observed candidate response IDs and bounded cadence to the tuned burst; retain packet failures before review and separately record observer, server and pending cleanup. Unattributed packet loss, incomplete timing, process ownership or cleanup cannot support PASS. A live server at timeout is left to the generic owned-session cleanup; no stale numeric PID is signalled.
